channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic and rain to Florida roads
item.description: A record-breaking number of Americans are hitting the roads this Fourth of July weekend, with travel challenges compounded by heavy rain across South Florida. item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach received the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, the only Florida city selected among 10 communities nationwide. Mayor Douglas Lawson called the recognition a proud moment for the city.

item.title: Juno Beach Town Council to debate fence replacement at JB-7 beach access in budget talks
item.description: Colony Condos residents say beachgoers are cutting through their private property at the JB-7 public beach access point after the town removed a fence in 2023. The council will take up the issue as part of budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit deploys two medic boats for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is expecting hundreds of boaters on the water this Fourth of July weekend. The team will have two boats with medics on standby in north and south Martin County.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiancée in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiancé Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many belongings.

item.title: Boca Raton Community High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march in Washington D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade on July 4 at 10:30 a.m., representing the entire state of Florida. Only bands nominated by state officials get invited to the prestigious event.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation offers tours, classes at historic Fort Pierce estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain at the historic Crain Estate. Visitors can take guided tours of the lush gardens and architecture every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed court documents Thursday opposing a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy who was suspended following social media comments about Charlie Kirk. item.title: St. Lucie County deputies make 15 DUI arrests in impaired driving enforcement
item.description: St. Lucie County deputies targeted impaired driving in a recent operation. The enforcement effort resulted in 15 DUI arrests.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for fence replacement at JB-7 beach access after trespassing complaints
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the fence in 2023. The dispute could cost the town thousands of dollars to resolve.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year on Treasure Coast
item.description: A holiday cookout meal for 10 now costs $73.82 according to the American Farm Bureau Federation, with ground beef up 5.5% and strawberries up 12.4% after a Florida frost.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied insurance coverage hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield coverage denied less than 24 hours before her reconstruction surgery involving GalaFlex surgical mesh.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams on standby as Fourth of July boaters hit the water
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is preparing for hundreds of boaters on the water this Fourth of July weekend with two boats and medics stationed in the north and south parts of the county.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's recommendation to reinstate teacher after Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy suspended last year following controversial social media comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida 2026 All-America City
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach is celebrating a major national honor after being named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. Riviera Beach was also the only Florida city selected for the honor this year.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football team aims for state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots are putting in the work this summer, setting their sights on a state title as they prepare for the 2026 fall football season.

item.title: Breast cancer patient and surgeon speak out after insurance denial hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage for breast reconstruction surgery by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before the procedure was scheduled, with the insurer saying the surgical mesh called GalaFlex is still considered investigational.

item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. item.title: North Palm Beach Country Club Hosts Fourth of July Fireworks and Pool Party
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Florida waives state park admission fees through Sunday for America's 250th anniversary
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection is offering free admission to state parks from Friday through Sunday to celebrate the nation's semiquincentennial.

item.title: DeSantis signs $117.6 billion Florida budget, vetoes $810 million in line items
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a $117.6 billion state budget this week, marking the fourth consecutive year of declining state spending. item.title: Southwest Florida communities stage fireworks, parades, and drone shows for 250th Independence Day
item.description: Fourth of July weekend brings celebrations across Southwest Florida as communities mark the nation's semiquincentennial with waterfront festivities.

item.title: Delray Beach opens 1976 Bicentennial Time Capsule as part of official America250 celebration
item.description: Delray Beach will crack open a time capsule from 1976 during its Fourth of July celebration, one of dozens of Florida events recognized as official America250 partner activities.

item.title: Marion County stages four synchronized fireworks displays for America's 250th anniversary
item.description: Marion County will launch fireworks at four locations simultaneously as part of Marion Celebrates 250, with entertainment starting at 5 p.m. and displays at 9 p.m.

item.title: Legal scholar highlights voting rights fight as central to America's 250-year history
item.description: The celebration of America's 250th anniversary must recognize the long struggle to fulfill the promise of the Declaration of Independence, according to a new book on founding father James Wilson.

item.title: Florida events tracked on national America250 calendar for semiquincentennial weekend
item.description: Florida communities are listed among dozens of official America250 partner events for the nation's 250th Independence Day celebration.

item.description: Deputies reported finding the body of a missing diver on the Florida coast.
